title: Daeyang Paper SCM Renewal
role: Sole publishing owner for all screens
introduction: I used shared components to build repeated screens for Daeyang Paper’s SCM. Reusing existing markup and styles reduced duplicate work and the scope of later changes.
myWorks: Systematized shared UI elements and applied a reuse-oriented structure
Ensured screen consistency through component-based publishing
Designed markup for maintainability and scalability
achievements: Reduced repeated markup and edit scope by reusing shared components
Contributed to a shorter schedule via publishing efficiency
points: Less duplicate markup and fewer change points
